text: The President of the Scarborough Community Renewal Organization (SCRO) will provide an update to Scarborough Community Council on their work on transit, employment lands and the Scarborough Walk of Fame, with the objective of supporting City of Toronto elected Councillors who represent Scarborough residents in creating a great place to work, live and play. The Scarborough Community Renewal Organization (SCRO) is committed to creating and realizing bold visions to renew Scarborough. Working collaboratively, through inspired action and learning, SCRO is a multi-stakeholder group of community-volunteers seeking to Renew Scarborough by advocating for economic development, better suburban planning, enhanced natural environment, social development and health promotion, as well as arts and culture.
The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Received the item for information.
